verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official MCP server so AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, etc.) can create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore and SQL Connect data through natural-language requests. Gemini in Firebase also adds a natural-language chat in the console and generates schemas, queries, and mutations on demand from natural language. Missing for 10: evidence that the in-console Gemini chat executes operations directly rather than mainly answering questions and generating code; natural-language operation of resources depends on an external MCP client; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
